episodes.synopsis: Yamanashi Kazuya is a first year Artist in Eisen High School's Perception Art Department. He's looking for his childhood friend, Takise Kyo, who is a third year Grader, but students from the two specializations are not encouraged to mix.
episodes.title: The Intersection of Colors #FFD900

episodes.synopsis: The Generals give the Staircaser candidates a chance to trade partners for the contest, but this leads to a fight between Artists and Graders instead.
episodes.title: A Knot in the Red Thread of Fate #D91E10

episodes.synopsis: As Kazuya and Kyo start working together on their piece for the Staircaser Contest, Kazuya reflects on their relationship and the relationship between Artists and Graders.
episodes.title: The Colors of Day and Night That Don't Overlap #F19072

episodes.synopsis: The Graders have a curation meeting to decide where their pieces will be displayed for the Staircaser Contest, and Kazuya wants to join, but Kyo won't let him.
episodes.title: The Transparent Color Waiting in the Woods We're Led To #00000000

episodes.synopsis: As Kazuya helps look for the culprit behind the mysterious Scribble, he talks to Anjyu and finds out about the stress he felt because of the Staircaser Contest.
episodes.title: Gray Thunder #6E60A8

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya and his friends find themselves in the middle of a fight between Mikuriya Kaede and Kirinoe Mashu in their search for answers about the mysterious Scribble.
episodes.title: Future Plans of Complementary Colors #000000

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya and Kyo go see Haijima Iori's exhibition, and Kazuya learns more about Iori's relationship with Kyo and with Takumi, his Grader for the Staircaser Contest.
episodes.title: The Emperor Loves That Color #20AEE5

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya thinks back to the time right before his parents' death and his family's relationship with Kyo's family during that time.
episodes.title: The Scene That Can Be Seen There #EAF4FC
The Room Hiding in the Color of Darkness #E4007F

episodes.synopsis: With the supported space update coming soon, Kazuya and the others are running out of time to find the Scribbler, but Kazuya is fighting with Kyo and Jun.
episodes.title: The Faint Distance of Orange #F36C21

episodes.synopsis: In his search for the Scribbler, Kazuya learns more about Kyo and Iori's relationship when they were partners for the Staircaser Contest two years ago.
episodes.title: The Heat Haze Clouded by Blue #C44303

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya finally realizes who drew the mysterious Scribble and finding the Scribbler leads him to answers about his past and the day his parents died.
episodes.title: COLORs #FFFFFF
